verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is itself an official, first-party SDK for Python and TypeScript, extensively documented with core agent-loop primitives, tools, MCP integration, hooks, permissions, sessions, structured outputs, and production hosting guidance, directly fulfilling the 'build against official SDKs' story. missing for 10: independent third-party validation of SDK reliability/performance and clearer resolution of community concerns about usage policy changes affecting SDK-based apps.
